summary: AccumulatorEngine: build()/build_all() construct a Lattice of maximal consistent rule combinations by level-wise expansion; apply()/apply_auto() evaluate a context against a lattice (or route it via LatticeIndex).
extension_points: build_all + index(lattices) -> LatticeIndex routes CONTEXT_KEY-partitioned contexts to the correct lattice.
lifecycle_notes: Renamed/relocated from top-level accumulator_engine.py to engines/accumulator/engine.py.
Apply-phase caching added: memoised filter engines and LatticeIndex per lattice (WeakKeyDictionary).

Ternary + specificity partition routing via an embedded meta-engine added for CONTEXT_KEY dimensions (feature/ternary-partition-routing, PR #48/#49) — NOT_SET fill for missing/null partition-key fields, EXACT_KEY match strategy powers the routing.
Each build level is materialised via relation(...).collect() — CLAUDE.md warns against lazy re-chaining (exponential plan blow-up).
risks: `import polars as pl` with an '# allow:' tag for the empty-build schema seed — one of three documented backend-purity exemptions, pending backend-agnostic empty-frame support in mountainash.

evidence.detail: import polars as pl  # allow: empty-build schema seed
